SELECT
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(o.order_approved_at AS DATE)))::int AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(o.order_approved_at AS DATE)))::int AS month,
  TO_CHAR(COALESCE(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(o.order_approved_at AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
  ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS total_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments op
  ON o.order_id = op.order_id
WHERE COALESCE(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE), CAST(o.order_approved_at AS DATE)) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY year_month ASC;
